description: 'Ask the pipeline': read-only tools over the Dagster instance (recent failures, run summary, redacted run logs, asset status, lineage, stale assets, receipt stats) for agents. Registers a resource and ships a stdio MCP server (python component.py) for agentic_pipeline's tool_use_loop / mcp_call.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource key the toolset is registered under (default dagster_instance_tools).

allow.label: Allow
allow.description: Hard allow-list of tools (default: all). Valid: list_recent_failures, get_run_summary, get_run_logs, asset_status, asset_lineage, stale_assets, receipt_stats.

max_result_chars.label: Max Result Chars
max_result_chars.description: Upper bound on the serialized size of any tool result (lists are halved / strings clipped, result flagged truncated).

definitions_module.label: Definitions Module
definitions_module.description: Optional 'pkg.module[:attr]' yielding your Definitions (attr defaults to `defs`). Enables downstream lineage, partition totals/missing, and data-version staleness; without it those degrade to event-log-only answers.

store_resource_key.label: Receipt Store Resource Key
store_resource_key.description: Optional resource key of a ContextReceiptStore; enables receipt_stats (asset_usage_since / outcomes_by_code_version).

mcp_server_resource_key.label: Mcp Server Resource Key
mcp_server_resource_key.description: If set, ALSO registers a stdio MCP-server-shaped resource (same name/type/command/env shape as MCPServerResource) under this key, built from this component's own settings -- python -m this module, with the DAGSTER_INSTANCE_TOOLS_* env vars set from allow/max_result_chars/definitions_module/store_resource_key's spec. DAGSTER_HOME, DAGSTER_CLOUD_DEPLOYMENT_NAME, and anything listed in mcp_extra_env_vars are read fresh from the environment at run time (when a consumer actually resolves this resource), not baked in at component load. Any mcp_servers-aware component (mcp_tool_call, mcp_tool_picker, the agent components, agentic_pipeline) can then reference it via server_resource_key instead of hand-writing an inline command+env entry. Leave unset to skip this -- existing resource_key-only behavior is unchanged.

mcp_extra_env_vars.label: Mcp Extra Env Vars
mcp_extra_env_vars.description: mcp_server_resource_key only. Extra env var NAMES to copy (their current value, read fresh every time a consumer resolves the resource) from this process into the spawned MCP server's env. MCP's stdio client does not inherit the rest of the environment, so anything your Dagster instance's own config needs beyond DAGSTER_HOME -- e.g. a Dagster+ agent's DAGSTER_CLOUD_AGENT_LABEL -- must be listed here, or the spawned server crashes at startup trying to resolve its instance.

name: dagster_instance_tools
